svg.title: Unresponsive touchscreen troubleshooting flowchart
svg.desc: A troubleshooting flowchart for an unresponsive Wombat touchscreen, followed by an advanced recovery procedure for restoring the default screen configuration.
svg.text: The touchscreen is not responding to your inputs
Try the quick checks below in order.
Stop as soon as the touchscreen becomes responsive again.
Loosen each case screw by 3–4 turns

text.tspan: Do not loosen the screws too much.
Opening the case will void your warranty.

svg.text: If the case was too tight, this often fixes it.
Stop touching the screen and wait 1–2 minutes
If BotUI is overloaded, it may recover on its own.
Too many fast inputs can temporarily make BotUI unresponsive.
Check your WombatOS version and update if needed

text.tspan: Wi-Fi-heavy environments can worsen this problem on some versions

svg.text: Use the WombatOS page to confirm or update firmware.
Either reflash the Wombat after backing up your programs,
or use the advanced recovery procedure below.
A bogus screen configuration can block touch input.
Email support@kipr.org so the support team can create a repair ticket.
